description: Atomic γ-3b — adds <send> (immediate + delayed) and <cancel> on top of γ-3a; pull-based scheduler with cancel-by-sendid (W3C SCXML 6.2 / 6.2.2). External targets, namelist, params, content, dynamic expressions, idlocation deferred to γ-4. <invoke> and binding=late remain reject-walled.
